assumptions.assumption: The average amount is a plain AVG of the unsigned trans.amount over all of an account's transactions. Direction does not matter for an unsigned average, so the undocumented VYBER type rows are included along with PRIJEM and VYDAJ.
The transaction count is all rows in trans for the account. The average transactions per account is total rows divided by the number of distinct accounts in trans.
The ratio is computed in floating point and not rounded. Ties at the 10-row cut are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: Average only over transactions whose type is PRIJEM (credit) or VYDAJ (withdrawal), excluding the undocumented VYBER rows. The count and ratio still use all transactions. Accounts with only VYBER rows get a NULL average.

assumptions.assumption: The average amount uses only rows with type PRIJEM (credit) or VYDAJ (withdrawal), as the request says 'credits and withdrawals'. The undocumented VYBER rows are left out of the average. Amounts are unsigned, so the plain amount is averaged and not netted by direction.

'How many transactions it has' and the all-account average count every row in trans, VYBER included. The ratio is the account's count divided by total rows / number of distinct accounts, in floating point and unrounded.
An account with only VYBER rows would get a NULL average but is still listed.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only credit and withdrawal transactions (PRIJEM and VYDAJ) for both the account's count and the all-account average, so the count matches the rows behind the average.

The transaction count, and the average transactions per account in the denominator, cover every row in trans, including VYBER rows. 'How many transactions it has' is read as all of the account's transactions, not just credits and withdrawals.
